# Changelog for huawei-cloud-msmodelslim-model-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial public release of the msModelSlim model analysis skill.
- Enables pre-adaptation analysis for candidate models, including implementation source detection (transformers or model-local), structural feature extraction, layer-by-layer loading assessment, and MoE fused weight risk evaluation.
- Provides detailed guidance on required input, analysis workflow, and expected output in the form of a structured Markdown analysis report.
- Clearly defines supported and unsupported use cases and model types.
- Sample documentation file (`skill-card.md`) has been removed.
summary: Analyze candidate models before adapter implementation. Determine model implementation source (transformers or model-local), structural features, layer-by-layer loading requirements, and MoE fused weight risks. Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) assess model adaptation feasibility before creating msModelSlim adapters, (2) analyze model structure and type classification, (3) evaluate MoE compatibility for quantization. Trigger: user mentions "model analysis", "msModelSlim", "adapter", "transformers", "MoE", "layer-by-layer", "model assessment", "feasibility", "模型分析", "适配可行性", "模型评估", "MoE分析"
